title: Breakup
body:
Fiery tears; rain.
Alove that bleeds.
Mourning colors of the mind;
cloudy sky.

Anger wind strong
the light of love is extinguished
And the thread of love
as long as a word is cut

Selfishness flares up.
Divorce looms large.
Feeling only obsessed,
without a drop of patience.

The Doctrine of Life
a power of the moment.
Myriads of love with wings
they fly everywhere and nowhere.
